notes.title: Save houses from the spreading fire in the puzzle game Wildfire Swap
notes.notes:
Forest fires are everywhere, they're spreading and it's up to you to ensure people's houses are safe in Wildfire Swap.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/04/save-houses-from-the-spreading-fire-in-the-puzzle-game-wildfire-swap
